Case and claim: Enel: continuity of allocation total and project identities
Evidence required and available: Requires identities and money by vintage. Six complete tables show an approximately EUR 986 million stock, but EUR 156.86 million moves from two deconsolidated projects to two already operating replacements in 2023.
Assessment: Contradicted for unchanged composition; reported total continuity is supported.
Unidentified: Eight hydro identities, complete cash/expenditure continuity and the causal effect on physical transition.

Case and claim: Iberdrola: continuity of names, total and monetary weights
Evidence required and available: Requires project-specific allocations. The 2019 hybrid retains two named projects and EUR 800 million across six reports; no monetary project split is disclosed.
Assessment: Names and total are supported; monetary continuity remains unidentified.
Unidentified: Project weights, realized refinancing shares and incremental financing effects.

Case and claim: SSE: continuity of allocation amounts and maturity at reporting cutoffs
Evidence required and available: Requires amounts and dated status. GB5 retains GBP 543.9 million across two reports; project operation dates differ. Gordonbush retains GBP 37.2 million and operational status at both snapshots.
Assessment: Monetary continuity is supported for two snapshots, including stable Gordonbush maturity; it does not establish uniform timing across projects.
Unidentified: Earlier allocations, within-year changes, complete ownership continuity and financing-induced delivery; Viking’s 443/434 MW discrepancy.
